info.name: Numark NS6
info.author: Osi Bluber - recorded from the hardware
info.description: Numark NS6 (original, USB 15e4:0079), all four decks. Needs a driver that presents the NS6 as a MIDI device: Numark's own on Windows and macOS, or ns6 (github.com/OsiPog/ns6-rs) on Linux, where the NS6 has no class-compliant MIDI interface at all.
